primary_game_plan: Establish exact UBR access and useful artifacts before casting Mishra, then convert the first safe combat into Warform value.
secondary_game_plan: Control the table while assembling artifact recursion, copy, extra-turn, or lock engines.
primary_win_lines: Gonti's Aether Heart extra turns with sufficient energy
common_tutor_priorities: an artifact to copy before Mishra combat
engine artifact appropriate to the board
interaction_priorities: protect the first meaningful Mishra combat
stop graveyard hate before committing recursion
hold cheap stack interaction for pivotal turns
mulligan_requirements: functional mana with a path to UBR
do not count total mana without checking colors
cards_normally_preserved: Red Elemental Blast against blue engines
Goblin Engineer/Welder when recursion is live
known_color_requirements: Mishra requires UBR plus two generic
red is needed for several interaction and recursion lines
blue supports countermagic and artifact engines
expected_development_turns: turns 1-2 deploy mana and cheap artifacts
turn 5+ cast Mishra with a protected combat target
threat_assessment: Do not expose Mishra without a useful noncreature artifact and a reasonable chance to reach beginning of combat.
